text: きたの　ヤマブキシティまで　ポッポに　てがみを　とどけて　もらうのさ！

structure.jp: きたの　ヤマブキシティまで
ポッポに　てがみを　とどけて　もらうのさ！
structure.en: I'm having my Pidgey deliver a letter!

patterns.name: 〜てもらう
patterns.span: ポッポに　てがみを　とどけて　もらう
patterns.explanation: もらう after a て verb says you get someone to do it for you; that someone is the word before に. ポッポにとどけてもらう = 'I have Pidgey deliver it'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end adds the feeling of explaining what is going on; さ is a breezy stand-in for だ. もらうのさ = 'you see, I'm having it done'.
